findings.conflicts_search: No dossier conflicts or current-law substantive leads appear. The machine missing-target label for EO 12741 is resolved by its newly supplied complete context, despite OCR spacing defeating the provision locator. Selected OFR search covers 6,938 catalog records from 1937 and operative sentences in 7,619 saved texts; it is adequate bounded later-order coverage for this 1989 historical order and includes both date amendments plus revocation. Four USC and four eCFR hits have no substantive snippets in this dossier and are not selected by the producer. No present operative predicate or exhaustive all-law search is inferred from their counts.
findings.earlier_ends: Original section 4(b) terminates the Committee December 31, 1990 unless extended. Newly full-held EO 12741 expressly replaces that date with December 31, 1991. Its hereby-ordered directive contains no deferred effect; immediate December 31, 1990 amendment is a reasoned execution-date inference. EO 12785 similarly replaces December 31, 1991 with December 31, 1992 on December 26, 1991. Thus neither superseded date is the Committee end. Original date text itself first ends on its replacement, as assigned to section 4(b); the seven Committee-specific provisions terminate December 31, 1992. Later express revocation is not substituted for those earlier ends.
findings.independent_delegation: I independently read section 4 before accepting the producer treatment. Its notwithstanding-any-other-order direction assigns responsibilities of the President under FACA to the Assistant or designee, with reimbursable GSA services, and contains no express with-respect-to-this-Committee limitation. Section 4(b) terminates the Committee rather than this order or the section 4(a) delegation. On that unqualified text, the retained delegation is a separate command; it is not discarded merely because the Committee expired. EO 12869 section 4(e) expressly revokes EO 12687 as amended, and section 6 expressly makes the order effective September 30, 1993. The latest first-end is therefore September 30, 1993, while the Committee itself ceased December 31, 1992. EO 12869 section 3 assigns FACA functions only for committees listed in its sections 1-2; it neither reestablishes this Committee nor saves its delegation after whole-order revocation.
findings.inventory: The complete one-page original supplies nine operative spans covering establishment and appointments; chair/secretary; advice; ongoing review and reports on request; agency information; compensation/travel; expenses; the unqualified FACA/GSA delegation; and Committee termination. Spans match held text, remain disjoint, and leave no substantive command omitted. Inventory overrides are unnecessary.
findings.savings: Section 3(b) statutory travel entitlements can leave accrued reimbursement claims; the order imposes no permanent compensation or separate continuing benefits program. Section 3(c) and GSA reimbursement may likewise leave accrued payment consequences. EO 12869 complete text transfers no surviving EO 12687 executive command and includes no saving retaining the broad delegation. transferred_or_accrued is an appropriate residual category, distinct from an operative Committee or delegated executive function.
